messages:
Dev Deploy Bot: Scheduled deploy window starting now for service: realtime-router. Applying feature flag 'ff:cohort-sticky' change as part of 2026-03 rollout. See release notes: https://go/redwood/releases/2026-03-realtime.
Maria (prod-eng): aiming for conservative rollout. propose start at 1% sticky cohorts for 20m then evaluate.
Jordan (releases): SGTM. add a gate: if p95 latency increases >10% or error rate >0.5% -> halt and pin back.
Santiago (infra): note that the cohort-sticky change interacts with rate-limiter. please enable per-user caps for the first 24h to avoid hot keys. I can flip `rate_limit.per_user=100` via infra flags.
Anya (oncall): +1 to per-user caps. also set alert: realtime-router.cpu > 70% for 5m. if triggered, roll back to previous ff variant.
Maria (prod-eng): can we do a staged plan: 1% -> 5% -> 10% over ~90m with manual checks at each step? I want traces and logs dashboard pinned.
Jordan (releases): yep. manual checkpoints at 20m and 60m. approvals from @Santiago and @Anya required to proceed.
Dev Deploy Bot: Executing: `ffctl toggle ff:cohort-sticky --cohort=experiment --percent=1`
Dev Deploy Bot: SUCCESS: ff:cohort-sticky set to 1% (operator: Maria). audit: https://go/redwood/audit/1750001234
Santiago (infra): infra knobs applied: `rate_limit.per_user=100`, `rate_limit.burst=20`.
Anya (oncall): watching metrics: p50=48ms, p95=120ms, errors=0.12% — looks healthy so far.
Maria (prod-eng): can we bump to 5% now?
Jordan (releases): hold 5m to confirm stabilty. if p95 remains <+8% and errors <0.4% -> ramp.
Dev Deploy Bot: Approved by: Maria, Santiago. Rolling to 5%. Executing: `ffctl toggle ff:cohort-sticky --percent=5`
Dev Deploy Bot: SUCCESS: now at 5%. linked metrics: https://go/redwood/metrics/realtime-router?range=15m
Anya (oncall): slight CPU uptick on a subset of pods (3/32 above 75%) — not yet in alert territory, but watch.
Santiago (infra): checking logs: a traffic skew from one customer is causing higher KV-cache misses. we should enable sticky-cohort decay to 30s for that cohort. I can toggle: `cohort.decay=30s` if agreed.
Maria (prod-eng): do that. set decay to 30s for experiment cohort only.
Dev Deploy Bot: Executing: `ffctl set-prop ff:cohort-sticky cohort=experiment decay=30s`
Dev Deploy Bot: SUCCESS: decay=30s applied.
Anya (oncall): alert fired: realtime-router.cpu > 80% for 5m on eu-west region. error rate bump to 0.9%. rolling back to 1% now.
Jordan (releases): do it. follow rollback checklist. notify support+clients if impact persists.
Dev Deploy Bot: Executing rollback: `ffctl toggle ff:cohort-sticky --percent=1`
Dev Deploy Bot: SUCCESS: rolled back to 1%. audit: https://go/redwood/audit/1750001234/rollback
Maria (prod-eng): good catch. Santiago, can you run a hotfix for KV-cache sizing and also prep a dataplane patch to spread that customer across more shards?
Santiago (infra): already on it. will post PR and small deploy in the 1h change window.
Anya (oncall): will keep monitoring. if CPU or errors cross thresholds again we escalate to P1 and pin the previous service version.
Jordan (releases): notes for release log: initial ramp to 5% triggered KV hotspots -> rollback to 1%. action items: KV cache sizing patch, cohort decay applied, add per-customer throttling. I'll update release notes with rollback reason.
Maria (prod-eng): thanks all. we'll re-run a controlled canary after KV fix. :thumbsup:
